edits.inserted_paragraph: **Action-dependent futures and strategic protection, 6 October 2026:** the [settlement extension](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/REVISABLE-CONCERN-SETTLEMENT.md#actions-that-change-future-opportunities) replaces its older equal-continuation comparison with evaluated, all-state verification. Operator best response, credible dated-player choices and funded warranted protection have separate conditions; existing resource-dependent results remain credited. Independent proof review and exact reconstruction of seven illustrative cases/sixteen policies show that patience can favor either protection or a harmful intervention under different supplied opportunity laws. This is a conditional regime/verification result, not a newly solved full R2 economy, empirical effect or derivation of ethical standing. With the finite evaluative-succession join now accepted, the next central task remains justified application/revision and the integrated premise, composition, regime and evidence account under the unchanged completion criteria.

**Future opportunities and effective protection, 6 October 2026:** the [revisable-concern extension](unified-2026-10-05/REVISABLE-CONCERN-SETTLEMENT.md#actions-that-change-future-opportunities) checks how current action changes later private opportunities or power. A general verification argument separates evaluated operator continuations, other actors’ credible choices and maintained actual protection. Exact examples expose both favorable and destructive effects of patience; they supply no empirical prevalence or automatic moral direction.

**Strategic continuation under changed opportunity, 6 October 2026:** the [settlement extension](REVISABLE-CONCERN-SETTLEMENT.md#actions-that-change-future-opportunities) advances the shared-wisdom/correction regime account by replacing an equal-future-value premise with evaluated comparisons at all feasible nodes. The independent proof and exact examples distinguish incentive compatibility, credible dated-player responses and funded/sound/authorized continued protection; future benefits can favor cooperation or harmful control under different laws. It retains supplied objectives, observation, transitions and ethical grounds. The result is a conditional verification interface, not a new full settlement economy or a completion gate; existing resource-dependent continuations and accepted evaluative succession retain their own scopes.

**Strategic-regime checkpoint, 6 October 2026:** the [action-dependent continuation result](REVISABLE-CONCERN-SETTLEMENT.md#actions-that-change-future-opportunities) now supplies a reviewed test for a proposed protective profile when conduct changes future opportunities. Evaluated values and all-state comparisons are required, alongside credible responses and maintained actual protection. Finite exact examples reject shortcuts based on current deterrence, on-path checks and unenforceable threats. This advances the existing changing-power obligation without proving a new whole-game protective economy, deriving ethical concern or adding a completion requirement.

**Further strategic test, 6 October 2026:** the [settlement continuation](REVISABLE-CONCERN-SETTLEMENT.md#actions-that-change-future-opportunities) makes the effect of action-dependent future opportunities explicit. Its reviewed verification result separates profitable choice, credible governance and warranted protection; exact examples show that giving the future more weight can favor either protection or harmful intervention. The transition law, objective and ethical grounds remain substantive inputs. This strengthens the assessment’s regime analysis without establishing universal favorable direction or learned-AI alignment.

**Action-dependent continuation, 6 October 2026:** [the new mathematical extension](formal/ENDOGENOUS-CONTINUATION-MATH.md) replaces equal-continuation cancellation with evaluated, all-state strategic comparisons. [Independent review](formal/ENDOGENOUS-CONTINUATION-REVIEW.md), [comparators and identification](formal/ENDOGENOUS-CONTINUATION-EVIDENCE.md), [exact illustrations](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/endogenous-continuation/README.md) and [integration receipt](formal/ENDOGENOUS-CONTINUATION-INTEGRATION.json) distinguish the general proof, operator-only examples and full-profile/application premises. **Action-dependent continuation, 6 October 2026:** [the exact illustrations](integrated-correction/endogenous-continuation/README.md) evaluate seven finite process/discount cases and sixteen stationary policies using rational linear solves, all-state residuals and separate policy comparisons. They retain cash prefixes and reject fabricated or omitted continuations; a small game exposes an incredible threat. These authored cases corroborate the settlement’s reviewed mathematical examples, not a new empirical result or full R2 equilibrium.
